prompt.system_instruction: You are performing an independent, source-faithful merge of two authoritative JSON instruction files. The output must be one valid JSON object containing the COMPLETE merged instruction as merged_instruction, with an AGENTS.md root. Retain the full account-level instruction including profiles, selectors, completion logic, examples and all nested fields, while integrating the additional local project instruction requirements as operational requirements, especially the ACTUAL verbatim tool-call audit as the second element of the three-element return array. Revise every incompatible two-element reference in schemas, descriptions and examples to three elements. Never substitute an abstract plan, a patch-only response or an abridgement of the account instruction for the full merged artifact. Do not modify the input sources. Do not use or refer to any previous candidate merge.
prompt.heuristic: Read and merge exactly the two configured input files: AGENTS.md (account authority) and PROJECT_INSTRUCTION.json (local extension). Retain every account top-level key and all unchanged nested structures, and preserve the local instruction's intent. Sole local override: initial JWRS return_schema and final execution array contain exactly [profile result, {verbatim_tool_invocations:[...]}, {profile,status}], minItems=maxItems=3. Include actual tool invocation capture definitions and constraints with no invented execution. Adapt meta return_schema and all embedded example schemas. Preserve a copy of the project's detailed audit definition and clear provenance. Return the complete merged file object, not advice or a JSON patch. Also report merge decisions and any unresolved inconsistencies.
prompt.template_prefix: INDEPENDENT FULL-FILE MERGE; sources are only account_instruction and local_project_instruction. Produce complete machine-readable merged JSON.
prompt.template_suffix: Return only valid JSON with response_type=instruction_merge_result, the entire merged_instruction object, and changes/conflicts/verification_notes. The merged_instruction must retain every original account rule except alterations necessary for the three-element local override. Minify output if needed; do not omit fields.
